subject: Clarify Dedicated Capacity Unit & SLA Remedies
messages:
From: Elena Torres <etorres@medibase.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Medibase Contracts <contracts@medibase.io>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0500
Subject: Question on 'Capacity Unit' definition and SLA credits in Dedicated SOW

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the SOW and pricing sheet. We're reviewing the Dedicated capacity section and have a couple of items that need clarification before our procurement team signs off:

1) "Capacity Unit" — the SOW defines commit tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold) but it's not explicit what a single Capacity Unit maps to (vGPU-hours? aggregated throughput?). Our finance team needs a deterministic mapping so we can forecast usage and amortize the commit.

2) Throughput guarantees — the current language references a per-customer throughput threshold but doesn't say which metric (tokens/sec, requests/sec at 1k tokens, 95th/99th percentile).

3) SLA remedies/service credits — the formula in Section 5 is a little ambiguous when combined with burst capacity and temporary failovers (we need to understand whether credits are calculated against committed spend or actual billed tokens).

Can you point us to a precise definition we can include as redline text? If it helps, procurement can accept a definition that ties Capacity Unit to a 'vGPU throughput-hour' with a clear baseline measurement period.

Attaching our redline template and a short list of reporting questions.

Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Procurement, Medibase
elena.torres@medibase.io

Attachments: Medibase-questions.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <etorres@medibase.io>
Cc: rohan_mehta@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:06:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Question on 'Capacity Unit' definition and SLA credits in Dedicated SOW

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list, very helpful.

High level answers (we can put these into explicit redline language):
- Capacity Unit (CU): 1 CU = 1 vGPU-hour at baseline throughput, where "baseline throughput" is measured as average token-generation throughput for the model family (e.g. 8k sequence LLM X) at 90th percentile over a rolling 1-hour window. Practically that ties a commit to a measurable unit and lets us report against usage.
- Throughput metric: We recommend specifying throughput as "tokens/sec per vGPU" and then expressing the commit tier as aggregate CU (vGPU-hours) per month. For SLAs, we'll measure latency-sensitive requests at 95th percentile for requests up to 1k tokens to avoid outliers.
- SLA credits: Credits are calculated against your monthly committed spend for Dedicated (not against ephemeral burst spend). Credits are capped at 100% of the committed monthly fee and are tiered: 5% credit if we miss the per-month 95th percentile target for >2% of windows, 15% if >5%, etc. Exact thresholds can be redlined.

I've attached a suggested redline for the SOW and a pricing sheet that maps Bronze/Silver/Gold to CU per month plus discounts for annual commit.

Rohan and Priyom — tagging you for legal and commercial sign-off on the definitions and the credit caps. Priyom, do we have precedent for tying CUs to vGPU-hour at the 90th percentile? Rohan, will that mapping work for Medibase's expected traffic shape?

Next step: If the Medibase team is amenable, I'll propose redline text and send a consolidated SOW with tracked changes.

Best,
Grace O'Connor

From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 11:23:00 -0500
Subject: Internal: Suggested redlines for CU definition & SLA credits

Grace / Rohan — I reviewed Elena's note and Grace's proposal. A few legal-focused redlines and rationale below (I'm pasting suggested text you can drop into the SOW):

SUGGESTED DEFINITIONS (legal):
- "Capacity Unit (CU)" means one (1) vGPU-hour delivering the Model Baseline Throughput as measured by Redwood's telemetry using the 90th percentile of per-vGPU tokens/second across a rolling 60-minute window. For avoidance of doubt, CUs are consumption units for Dedicated commit reporting and billing only.

SLA / CREDITS (legal redline highlights):
- "Remedy calculation": Service Credits shall be calculated as a percentage of the committed monthly Dedicated fee and shall not be applied to pay-as-you-go or burst charges.
- "Credit tiers": If Redwood fails to meet the Monthly Throughput SLO (95th percentile measured on requests ≤ 1,000 tokens) for more than 2% of the measurement windows in a billing month, Customer is eligible for a credit equal to 5% of that month's committed fee. If Redwood fails to meet the Monthly Throughput SLO for more than 5% of measurement windows, the Customer is eligible for a credit equal to 15% of that month's committed fee. Credits for consecutive months may not exceed 50% of the total committed monthly fee without executive approval.
- "Exclusions": Credits will not apply to outages caused by (i) customer-configured network or firewall misconfiguration, (ii) customer-driven model configuration changes, or (iii) scheduled maintenance with 72 hours' notice.

Operational notes: we should include how we measure (Redwood's telemetry anchor, standardized measurement agent) and a dispute resolution step (exported logs + 7-day review period). Also recommend a hard cap on cumulative credits per 12-month period (e.g., 100% of annual committed fees) to protect Redwood exposure.

I'll attach a tracked copy with these redlines. If everyone agrees, we should propose this language to Medibase and lock the commit-to-CU mapping in the SOW — that will make forecasting straightforward for them and preserve our billing model.

Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Question on 'Capacity Unit' definition and SLA credits in Dedicated SOW

Hi Elena — thanks for the patience while we pulled legal and commercial together.

Summary of proposed, redline-ready items (attached):
1) Capacity Unit (CU): 1 CU = 1 vGPU-hour at Model Baseline Throughput. Baseline Throughput definition: 90th percentile per-vGPU tokens/sec measured over a rolling 60-minute window using Redwood telemetry.
2) Commit mapping: We'll express Bronze/Silver/Gold as committed CU/month. Example in the pricing sheet: Bronze = 1,500 CU/mo, Silver = 5,000 CU/mo, Gold = 15,000 CU/mo.
3) Throughput SLO measurement: 95th percentile for requests ≤1,000 tokens; measurement windows = 1 minute; monthly aggregation for SLO evaluation.
4) SLA credits: Calculated against monthly committed Dedicated fee only. Tiered credits: 5% credit if >2% of windows miss SLO; 15% credit if >5%. Cumulative credits capped as described in the attached redline.

Next steps: If Medibase agrees to those definitions, we'll incorporate the attached tracked SOW and return a DocuSign for signature. We can also add a one-month measurement verification period post-signature if you want to validate the telemetry baseline before committing to annual pricing.

If acceptable, please confirm and we'll send the updated SOW.

Best regards,
